settings.beta.title: Beta Features
settings.beta.subtitle: Experimental features — off by default and may change
settings.beta.hud.detail: Installs the companion HUD mod on Fabric instances and syncs the Studio layout into the game. Disabling removes the mod again.
settings.beta.ui.detail: Shows the Neo Studio in-game UI editor (NeoCraft UI mod theme) as a beta feature.
settings.beta.radar.detail: Shows a seed-derived biome minimap and quick actions for each world.
settings.beta.args.detail: Adds JVM and game argument fields to the instance editor for power users.
settings.beta.bedrock.detail: Adds a Java/Bedrock edition picker to instances. Bedrock runs through NeoCraft Bedrock — Play installs it on demand.
settings.beta.bedrockServers.detail: Host Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Servers (Windows BDS via Wine) in the Servers tab — independent of Bedrock gameplay.
